summary.text: Steve Conway, a Democrat from Tacoma, has served the 29th Legislative District since 1993, first as a state representative for 18 years and then as a senator since 2011. His official biography lists him as President Pro Tempore and a member of the Labor & Commerce and Ways & Means committees.

paragraphs.text: Conway earned a master's and a doctoral degree in history from the University of Oregon and served as a Fulbright Fellow at the London School of Economics, according to his official biography.
Before his election to the legislature he was a business agent for the United Food and Commercial Workers Union, Local 81, the page says.

The page describes him as a spokesperson for working families who supports collective bargaining rights, with a focus on health care, working conditions and retirement benefits for Washington's workforce.
It says he and his wife Georgia have been married since 1968 and have two sons and four grandchildren.
